scope: Evidence serialization only; product pass criteria and TC independence remain in approved implementation contract.
recording: Record each case only after independent assertions. Evidence markers do not replace exact TC testcase inventory, real PostgreSQL/FS assertions or actual child process proof. Extra cases use additional_cases.

required_fields.exit_code: exact int, normal0 or expectedSIGKILLnegative as asserted by TC

process_identity.start_ticks: canonical decimal Linux /proc/<pid>/stat field22 captured from confirmed Popen handle before wait

processes.requirement: At least one cli_run and one crash_worker plus >=2 independent worker processes in the TC concurrency cases; no PID/path/credential/raw output is promoted.
processes.identity: Require unique (pid,start_ticks) per recorded process and at least2 successful reconciler identities; actual live-claim TC case asserts holder/contender are different processes while holder remains alive. Drop identities from published report.
processes.raw_logs: Each record i has retained private workspace-process-logs/process-{i:03d}-{stdout,stderr}.log under observation directory. Verify actual regular file mode0600/directory0700, bytes and SHA before publication.

no_canaries: true only after actual worker stdout/stderr/private-error scans; raw data remains private0700/0600.
limits: Controlled ENOSPC and committed-PG acknowledgment wrapper exceptions are injected fault proof, not real disk-capacity/network/power-loss evidence.
Loopback/local synthetic service evidence only; no original AT completion or production workspace policy acceptance.
